## What this adds / Kaj dodaja

<!-- A routine, a translation, images? / Rutino, prevod, slike? -->

## Checklist / Kontrolni seznam

- [ ] No real people, names, text, brands, logos, flags or known characters in images. / Na slikah ni resničnih oseb, imen, napisov, znamk, logotipov, zastav ali znanih likov.
- [ ] No child's name, photo or other personal details in routines, commits or this pull request. / V rutinah, commitih in tej zahtevi ni otrokovega imena, fotografije ali drugih osebnih podatkov.
- [ ] I generated or drew every image myself; none is taken or edited from the web or stock collections. / Vsako sliko sem ustvaril ali narisal sam; nobena ni vzeta ali predelana s spleta ali iz zbirk.
- [ ] I searched each new image on the web (e.g. Google Lens, Exact matches) and found no copies. / Vsako novo sliko sem poiskal na spletu (npr. Google Lens, Exact matches) in nisem našel kopij.
- [ ] Each image has its `.json` with model, full prompt and license `CC0-1.0`. / Vsaka slika ima svoj `.json` z modelom, celotnim pozivom in licenco `CC0-1.0`.
- [ ] I ran `python3 tools/check_images.py` and `python3 tools/build.py` and committed `output/`. / Pognal sem oba ukaza in commital `output/`.
- [ ] I dedicate my contribution to the public domain under CC0 1.0. / Svoj prispevek dajem v javno last po CC0 1.0.
